title: Uptowns Extra Inventory
description: This plugin adds extra inventory with 54 slots under command /inv. Has a config
body:
This plugin adds extra inventory under the command /inv. Extra inventory has 54 slots that are easly configured in config.yml.

As a admin you can see other people extra inventories but you can't edit them. 

I suggest using a command keybinding mod to use the plugin more efficient



The plugin actually comes from my smp: UptownSMP!
